ns2:section.sectionText: This course studies a topics related to money, banking, and financial markets. In first part of the course, we will cover the basics of financial markets and assets traded in those markets. Second part of the course covers monetary policy and how FED regulates markets with it. ********RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS MAJORS.
